name: ide-php
author: lumine-code
description: Provide PHP language intelligence through PHPantom.

serverPath.title: Server Path
serverPath.description: Absolute path to phpantom_lsp. Leave empty to use the managed copy or a native executable on PATH.

notifyWhenMissing.title: Notify When Missing
notifyWhenMissing.description: Offer to install PHPantom when its executable is missing.

features.title: Features
features.description: Choose which PHPantom results the editor uses.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Report PHP syntax, type and member problems.

autocomplete.title: Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: Complete project symbols and PHP standard-library members.

hover.title: Hover
hover.description: Show symbol documentation and resolved type information.

signature.title: Signature Help
signature.description: Show parameters while entering a function or method call.

definition.title: Go To Definition
definition.description: Navigate to definitions, implementations and resolved types.

references.title: Find References
references.description: Find symbol occurrences across the project.

typeHierarchy.title: Type Hierarchy
typeHierarchy.description: Inspect class and interface inheritance through PHPantom's dynamic capability.

symbols.title: Symbols
symbols.description: Provide document and workspace symbols for navigation.

format.title: Format
format.description: Format PHP documents with the built-in formatter or project tools.

rename.title: Rename
rename.description: Rename symbols and update their project references.

codeActions.title: Code Actions
codeActions.description: Apply fixes and source refactorings supplied by PHPantom.

inlayHints.title: Inlay Hints
inlayHints.description: Show parameter names and inferred information beside source code.

codeLens.title: Prototype Lenses
codeLens.description: Show executable links to inherited method prototypes.
